title: Researchers in Vienna and Beijing report nuclear clock “milestone”
summary: Two papers published recently in Nature report what the journal describes as “the first implementation of a nuclear clock, a milestone in the field of metrology.” The research behind both papers involve the radioisotope thorium-229. “A thorium-229 optical nuclear clock with feedback loop,” by Luca Toscani de Col et al., describes research led by a team from the Vienna Center for Quantum Science and Technology in Austria. “A nuclear clock synchronized to 229Th,” by Beichen Huang et al., describes research by a team from Tsinghua University and the Beijing Academy of Quantum Information Sciences in China.

title: Danish Decommissioning files final repository proposal
summary: Plans for Denmark to establish a final repository for its nuclear waste moved forward on October 2, when state-owned entity Danish Decommissioning announced that it had submitted a proposal for such a facility to the Danish Agency for Civil Security. The proposal marks a continuation of efforts that began in 2018 with the Danish Parliament’s passage of Proposal B 90. That legislation called for geological assessments of sites in Denmark to a depth of 500 meters, the goal being to support construction of a deep geological repository that would be operational by 2073.

title: NRC reviews LAR on Palisades fuel loading incident, as Pioneer SMR application advances
summary: The Nuclear Regulatory Commission is reviewing a license amendment request (LAR) Holtec submitted in the aftermath of a fuel loading incident that has paused some of the restart work at the Palisades nuclear power plant in Covert, Mich.

title: Louisiana roots, Arkansas service: Landen May named Lineman of the Game
summary: Landen May never expected a college side job to lead him to a career in linework — much less to the field at a New Orleans Saints game. But on October 11, the Louisiana native and Entergy Arkansas lineman will return to his home state to be recognized as Entergy Arkansas’s Lineman of the Game during the Saints’ matchup against the Minnesota Vikings.
